_doc: Super Yap SPEC — the LOADED yap. Engine: superyap.py. Human doc: memory super yap feature template. Clean Yap counterpart: cleanyap.json. Composes from the full component menu (creative-vault/components/) — I act as creative director, not a template-filler.

format.name: Super Yap
format.definition: the loaded version: everything Clean Yap PLUS doodle-sticker layers, full-screen takeover, stat cards, b-roll cutaways/bursts, punch-ins, heavy animations, and CUSTOM motion graphics composed per content.
format.ask_up_front: animation style (per the creator's rule — ask at the START of each Super Yap)

doneness._axis_note: Doneness (how baked) is a SEPARATE axis from format — it applies to Clean Yap too, not just Super Yap (locked). Pick per reel.
doneness.raw: editable CapCut text + native Auto Captions (superyap.py editable-text path).
doneness.medium_well: type as Claude-rendered NAMED .mov layers (build-hf-captions.py -> build-overlay.py); footage / graphics / SFX editable.
doneness.well_done: fully baked flat MP4, nothing editable (build-reel-type.py).

creative_direction_pass._note: Customize every video per content. Pitch suggestions. Be a world-class creative director — soft touches, custom cards, custom motion graphics that make sense for the content. Visual storytelling that's captivating. Use your FULL capabilities, not my limited understanding of what's possible.
steps: 1. Read the finished-script transcript beat by beat.
2. For each beat, ask: would a custom card / motion graphic make the STORY land harder here? (Not decoration — storytelling.)
3. Pitch the per-beat plan to the creator with specific components (from creative-vault/components/) + any NEW custom idea.
4. the creator approves/adjusts. Then build once, patch after (never full rebuild).
creative_direction_pass.restraint: Not every beat gets a graphic. Earn each one. But DO reach beyond the known menu — pitch new components.

component_menu: creative-vault/components/README.md — compose from the FULL menu; add new components as we invent them.

full_capabilities._note: CONTINUING to add motion graphics to Super Yaps — this list grows. Utilize the whole engine.
full_capabilities.hyperframes: Render rich motion graphics as .mov overlays via HyperFrames 0.8.43 (48 animation rules, 22 blueprints, AI image/video gen). Use for: full-screen ILLUSTRATIVE takeovers with a storyline, chat threads, callouts, notes/journal cards, search-bar reveals, animated diagrams.
full_capabilities.animate_her_assets: Grab from ~/brand-assets (55-icon doodle pack, product covers, GROW screenshots, b-roll) and animate them ON screen as INDIVIDUAL editable layers (slide/zoom/pop) — never baked.
full_capabilities.illustrative_storyline: A rendered illustrated scene under the VO that tells a mini-story (not just words on screen).
full_capabilities.editable_first: Base + her assets stay individually editable in CapCut; HyperFrames pieces import as finished .mov clips. Never compound/group.
